domains.notable_signal: My_browser implements an explicit Execution→Observation→Evidence→Verification→Provenance/History kernel and an external-MCP-JSON ingestion bridge.
canonical-capability-core separates qualification, authorization, action, observation and reconciliation; Llms-mcp-android contains Action/Capability/Policy/Approval/Egress boundaries.
Multiple repositories expose MCP servers, ingestion, routing or connector documentation; most remain signal-only until implementation-specific evidence is inspected.
The portfolio contains independent restart/recovery, durable-state, conversation-continuity and capability-lifecycle lines that may be experimentally composable.
Typed decision contracts, deterministic ledgers and relationship-aware control surfaces appear as distinct mechanisms; no unification is assumed.
droidrun provides a reusable external reference for natural-language mobile control and tracing; provenance/lineage relative to first-party code has not been established.
The portfolio contains several orchestration concepts, but README claims are not treated as implementation evidence.
All-time is the clearest current browser-local inference/PWA implementation line; Open-System-One adds a typed decision substrate and browser ONNX research path.
Conversational provides repository-native continuity and provenance; HOLONOMY is a separate external/protocol-style memory and path-integrity reference.
These projects independently preserve mutation, replay, provenance, or security validation patterns; reuse requires mechanism-level extraction.

next_route.question: Can the acquisition/evidence lifecycle be attached to a real browser-local inference run without coupling source semantics to the kernel?
Which continuity/recovery primitives remain distinct after one controlled restart/replay experiment?
Can capability qualification and authorization be represented as a portable mechanism without importing unverified trust?
Can typed decision state and deterministic contradiction handling be composed without turning either into an aggregate-truth layer?

boundary: This map is a capability-discovery artifact, not a ranking, approval list, architecture decision, or proof of reuse.
